scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: Verilog simulated counter
Verilog function and arithmetic
checks.code: module main; function integer square; input integer n; begin square=n*n; end endfunction initial begin $display("%0d",square(7)); $finish; end endmodule

checks.name: Verilog four-state X and Z
checks.code: module main; reg [3:0] bits; initial begin bits=4'b10xz; $display("%b",bits); $finish; end endmodule

checks.name: Verilog delayed combinational assignment
checks.code: module main; reg a,b; wire y; assign y=a & b; initial begin a=1;b=0;#1;$display("%b",y);b=1;#1;$display("%b",y);$finish;end endmodule

checks.name: Verilog multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code: module main; reg [8191:0] line; integer n; initial begin repeat (2) begin n=$fgets(line,32'h80000000); if(n>0) $write("%0s",line); end $finish; end endmodule

checks.name: Verilog syntax rejection
checks.code: module main initial begin $display("must_not_run"); end endmodule

checks.name: Verilog elaboration rejects undefined module
checks.code: module main; museum_missing_module x(); initial $display("must_not_run"); endmodule
